s2:A Tale of Two Stars: X-Ray and Ground-based Observations of Two Diverging Stars

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the discrepancies between X-ray diagnostics and UV-NIR accretion tracers in symbiotic X-ray systems like 4U 1700+24. They focus on related topics in accretion processes but do not address this specific question.
